title: Lenny Rachitsky (Lenny's Newsletter — top Substack in product / ~1M subscribers) picks Incorruptible for the Friends of Lenny's Newsletter book club, with Eric joining for a Q&A
summary: Lenny Rachitsky — author of Lenny's Newsletter (Substack's top-ranked product & startup publication with ~1M subscribers) and host of Lenny's Podcast; ex-Airbnb product lead — announces that his 'Friends of Lenny's Newsletter' Slack community voted Incorruptible as this month's book club pick, with Eric joining the community this week for a Q&A. 35 likes on the launch post.
blockquote:
Each month in the "Friends of Lenny’s Newsletter" Slack community members vote to read a great book about building and talk about it in our book club.

This month’s pick is "Incorruptible: Why Good Companies Go Bad and How Great Companies Stay Great," and the incredible Eric Ries is joining us this week for a Q&A.
